pages.title: SanMar Downloads · Northwest Custom Apparel
pages.mainText: Download SanMar files Refresh These are the data files SanMar publishes on their FTP server. Click Download to save one to your computer — no FileZilla needed — then import it into Caspio. The product & pricing master is SanMarPI-Bulk; it feeds garment CASE_PRICE into every quote builder. SanMar pricing changes only every few months, so grab a fresh copy when it does. After you download — import into Caspio Caspio app Sanmar Pricing 2026 → table Sanmar_Bulk_251816_Feb2024 → Import the CSV you just downloaded. Import mode: Update & add records, match on UNIQUE_KEY. Leave unmapped so your own values are kept: IsTopSeller, IsNew, Display_Image_URL (formula). Done — this one table feeds every quote builder, so all pricing surfaces refresh within ~15 min (Customer Catalog, Quick Quote, and the DTG/DTF/EMB/SCP builders). This is the table that runs pricing Sanmar_Bulk_251816_Feb2024 is the single garment-cost source for all quote builders. After a big import, spot-check a couple of styles and confirm a changed price shows the same in the Catalog, Quick Quote, and a Quote Builder. How this works SanMar FTPftp.sanmar.com this page Downloadto your PC Caspio import Sanmar_Bulkproduct master CASE_PRICE All quote builders Host ftp.sanmar.com · user 6920 · plain FTP Pricing master in /SanMarPDD/SanMarPI/ (SanMarPI-Bulk-*.csv) Downloads stream through the app — nothing stored on the server Prefer a one-click desktop tool? There's also Download-SanMar-Pricing.bat in the sanmar-ftp-box folder — double-click it to pull the newest pricing file straight to your Downloads folder without opening this page. Same file, same next step (import into Caspio). One-time setup The download buttons need the SanMar FTP password stored on the app as the config var SANMAR_FTP_PASSWORD (with optional SANMAR_FTP_USER, default 6920). Once it's set, this page works for any admin — no local FileZilla or password prompts.

pages.title: SanMar → ShopWorks Parts · Northwest Custom Apparel
pages.mainText: Convert a price list Pick a SanMar price list and click Convert. It runs entirely in your browser (nothing is uploaded), then you download a CSV ready to import into ShopWorks → Parts. It auto-detects the file: a ShopWorks Integration Only Price List (already formatted) gets the sizes added to its descriptions and _2XL→_2X fixed; a raw SanMar feed is fully converted (colors collapsed, part numbers, prices, size flags, sizes in descriptions). Choose file No file selected Convert Reset 0 rows in 0 parts out Download CSV ID_ProductDescriptionPieceCaseSizes Preview shows the first 12 rows. The download contains all of them. What the converter does Descriptions get the size. Extended-size rows become Size 3XL - …, Size 2XL - …, Size OSFA - … — matching how your existing parts read. 2XL part numbers are fixed. _2XL → _2X so an import updates your existing parts instead of creating duplicates. Ladies _XXL parts are left alone. One part per style + size. On a raw feed, colors collapse to a single part (highest/standard piece price), with the ShopWorks size-limit flags set (Size01–04 base, Size05 for 2XL/XXL, Size06 for everything else). Prices & brand carried through. Piece / Dozen / Case pricing and brand come straight from the feed. Two ways to get a price list Use ShopWorks's monthly "Sanmar Integration Only Price List", or pull the raw SanMar feed yourself from the SanMar Downloads page / FileZilla. Either one works here. Then import into ShopWorks Download the CSV above. In ShopWorks (OnSite), import it into Parts — it matches on ID_Product, so existing parts update and new ones are added. Spot-check a couple of styles (e.g. 29M_2X reads Size 2XL - …).
